decision: Proceed with a separately named offline retrospective credit audit; defer any new reward activation until support and label semantics are verified. No new reward has been implemented or tested here.
core_findings_zh: 值得补充未来后代标签，作为检验即时目标与后期目标不一致的一个角度；现有结果不能证明该不一致是唯一退化原因。
末端存活和存活条件下后代head均值是两个不同目标。灭绝仅表示其反事实后期评分未被观察，不能编码为低亲和力。
原始14批真实包含score=.50→state=.51的第51次重采样。终末谱系必须跨过它；因此本提案是严格窗口内坐标特征配以窗口外未来标签，不是旧有严格边界存活分析。
早期终末祖先极少：t0/t.1中位数均1。不能在这些节点强行构造高低terminal-credit组，也不能重复唯一祖先来凑教师数。
均匀权重给予唯一祖先和独立批次，可减少多后代祖先支配，但仍没有消除条件存活、共同根、子代复制和未来SMC策略偏差。
第99步head来自t=.99的既有联合forward，既不是第99步之后的最终corrector输出，也不是硬解码终态在.9999上的独立rescore。

mapping_contract.index_semantics: selected_indices[j,k] is the pre-selection candidate slot at step j that becomes post-selection/next-current slot k. Scores and predicted_coords at step j are stored before that resampling.
mapping_contract.backward_recursion: A[j,l]=selected_indices[j,A[j+1,l]], j=98,…,0. This traverses all actual intermediate selection edges, including j=50, and identity edges thereafter.
mapping_contract.do_not_apply: Do not apply selected_indices[99] when attaching pic50_on[99] to step99 candidate slots. If using an actual final-output label, first verify its slot mapping and include the final-selection map as required.
mapping_contract.terminal_credit: C[j,i]=Σ_{l:A[j,l]=i} head99[l]/N[j,i] for N>0; otherwise NA.
mapping_contract.moment_accumulation: Maintain count, sum(head99) and sum(head99²) by backward bincount. Verify all nodes preserve total count50 and total label sum; these are algorithm checks, not independent replicate counts.
mapping_contract.boundary_distinction: Current features are still only steps0…49. Future ancestry and label metadata must explicitly record the last real resampling at score.50/state.51 and label time.99. Do not copy endpoint .50/.51 or final coordinates into the predictor table.
mapping_contract.observed_checks: All fourteen original SHA bindings match; all100×50 indices are valid; all nonresampling rows and selected_indices[99] are identity; count and score sums conserve. A recorded step49→50 current/proposal selection equality was checked in batch0.

motivation_evidence.interpretation: Development batches only. Window recorded-head changes and final decoded-rescore changes have different measurement semantics. Their sign disagreement motivates a long-horizon-label audit but does not quantify a causal forgetting effect. R7 is a positive counterexample; larger R12 dose is not the sole solution.
alternative_causes: Native continuation and detached self-conditioning dynamics
Native graph/category drift despite coordinate-only intervention
Different latent joint-head versus decoded-rescore semantics
Adaptive small-development-set selection and correlated lineage noise

minimal_mining_plan.predictors: Reuse the predeclared200 endpoint regional moments, receptor landmarks and radius5Å at all50 actual learning nodes. Do not select new regions or atom types.
minimal_mining_plan.primary_survival_contrast: For each batch/node, mean(phi over unique candidate ancestors with S=1) minus mean(phi over unique candidate nodes with S=0), each candidate counted once. Extinct nodes provide a survival-selection contrast only.
minimal_mining_plan.primary_scale: Reuse and bind the existing regional per-field scale for a minimal target-label comparison; disclose it is candidate-std based rather than root-balanced. Preserve raw-unit means as well.
primary_measures: Trapezoid standardized survival contrast across the full observed0… .49 grid divided by.49
Last-minus-first standardized survival contrast divided by.49
Exact observed50-node mean curves and finite-difference time derivatives, with denominators/coverage at every node
minimal_mining_plan.support_rule: The survival contrast is algebraically defined when both groups are nonempty; retain it descriptively even when only one ancestor survives, with counts/root diagnostics. Do not pretend that the early survivor group contains independent evidence proportional to its terminal clone count.
minimal_mining_plan.statistical_units: Equal14 discovery batches; bootstrap entire batch curves, seed fixed and recorded. Predeclare a single joint BH family for the200 level plus200 change-rate tests if these are the only tested inferential measures; expanding to credit/edge/whole-curve tests requires an explicit expanded or separately identified family, never reuse V1 q values.
minimal_mining_plan.secondary_credit_analysis: Within surviving unique ancestors, inspect C versus same-node recorded score, C minus same-node score, and feature versus C association controlling same-node score only where sufficient rank and variation exist. These remain policy-conditioned observational summaries; no fitted inference-time predictor is required.
minimal_mining_plan.secondary_missingness: No credit estimate for extinct nodes. No zero-filling or median filling. For high/low-credit quartiles require at least3 actual unique ancestors in each nonoverlapping group and report ties; for partial correlation predeclare minimum n/rank. Many early nodes will be unsupported.
minimal_mining_plan.whole_window_rule: Do not silently integrate only supported late nodes and call the result whole-window. Full-window formal credit-contrast testing is deferred if curves are structurally missing; retain sparse descriptive node summaries and explicit observed intervals instead.
lineage_sensitivities: Equal-current-parent or equal-root weighting as separate sensitivity estimands, with root-count coverage; they cannot create roots absent from the data.
Compare terminal S against strict-state<=.5 boundary S to expose the extra.50 selection decision.
Report equal-ancestor terminal means separately from descendant-count-weighted means, count ranges, descendant dispersion and within-root spread.
compact_outputs: manifest.json with separate feature window, ancestry horizon and label horizon/source fields and hashes
700-row batch_node_moments.parquet with group means/contrasts and optional observed credit associations only
700-row lineage_counts.parquet with unique survivor/extinct counts, terminal descendants, roots and label coverage
whole_window_effects.parquet plus exact node functions/derivatives; no particle×200 feature cache
small teacher metadata and one coordinate library only if a subsequent reference is approved

teacher_prior_proposal.status: Exploratory return-conditioned imitation target, not an estimated causal value function or gradient of expected final affinity.
teacher_prior_proposal.candidate_set: Use only actually observed unique candidate ancestors at each0… .49 node; each stores its original endpoint point cloud, C, current recorded score, descendant count/dispersion, root and source-node identity. Do not average coordinates across ancestors.
teacher_prior_proposal.selection: Within each discovery batch, deterministically rank eligible surviving ancestors by C; then retain spatially distinct full point clouds using fixed-frame Hungarian RMS, stable tie-breaking and a predeclared small per-batch cap (e.g.2 to match the existing nominal cap). Distinctness is not a chemical graph gate.
teacher_prior_proposal.sparse_nodes: If a batch has one ancestor, include it once with an explicit no-within-batch-ranking flag. Never duplicate it to fill2 slots or infer a second spatial mode; missing batches remain missing.
teacher_prior_proposal.base_weights: Equal batch mass and equal selected-ancestor mass within each represented batch, not descendant count N. Store base weights explicitly; K-neighbor truncation and score/geometric reweighting alter effective batch masses and must be disclosed.
teacher_prior_proposal.credit_weighting_caveat: C itself averages realized terminal leaves and therefore still reflects clone allocation within that ancestor. Equal weighting among ancestors does not make the entire estimator clone-independent. A recursively branch-balanced credit would be a different estimand and should be a separate sensitivity, not silently substituted.
teacher_prior_proposal.formula_candidate: For fixed assignment/anchor, logπ_bk=log(1/B_supported)+log(1/K_b)−d_anchor,bk²/T+β*c_bk; R_t(Y)=τ logΣ_bk π_bk exp[−δ²(sqrt(1+q_bk(Y)/δ²)−1)/τ], with the existing regional or full-cloud q held fixed as an architectural choice.
teacher_prior_proposal.credit_normalization: Raw terminal credit and within-batch centered/rank credit are distinct targets. Predeclare one, retain both diagnostics and avoid inverse small-variance amplification. Early single-ancestor batches have no within-batch credit contrast.
teacher_prior_proposal.isolation: To test label horizon, hold coordinate representation, landmarks, attention, native dose/caps and window fixed. Compare instantaneous-label and terminal-label libraries built on a matched eligible population/cardinality where possible. If survival eligibility, teacher count/diversity or base weights also change, label the trial as a compound target-construction intervention.
teacher_prior_proposal.temporal_consistency: Keep source node/parent identities for teachers; quantify target switching and deduplicate merged lineage paths. A per-node best teacher is not automatically one coherent optimal path.
teacher_prior_proposal.runtime_contract: If later implemented, use the existing one-native-forward FLOWR coordinate VJP with detached condition/assignment/attention/prior and native continuation after the window. Terminal labels are fixed offline constants; no head loss, extra production forward, NN, SMC or graph acceptance gate.
teacher_prior_proposal.parameter_status: No new eta/beta/teacher thresholds are frozen by this review. Existing measured parent remains the comparison until a separately reviewed implementation and experiment.

bias_and_label_limits: Survival is produced by stochastic score-biased resampling; extinct counterfactual terminal scores are missing not at random. Finite selected paths do not identify the outcome that an extinct candidate would have achieved.

At early times the experiment collapsed to1–2 roots per batch; descendant multiplicity and nearby times cannot increase independent replication. A high terminal mean may describe one fortunate continuation or graph trajectory.

Survival with no later resampling is already determined by the last resampling event. Here all paths after step50 are identity, so terminal-survival alone adds no new survival information beyond the post-.51 population; later recorded-head credit is the added signal.

Head99 is a latent joint-forward score at t=.99 on the recorded trajectory. Final output/corrector and the explicit hard-categorical final rescore are separate measurements. No matched head99-versus-decoded-rescore bridge was computed here; final_records are absent from this compact source directory.
Improved credit association after adjusting the current score would still condition on survival and latent graph/chemical evolution; it does not isolate an independent coordinate effect.

Using future labels from discovery trajectories is valid retrospective supervision, but it deliberately relaxes the old rule that every information source is inside the control window. Keep the feature window and outcome horizon separate in manifests and descriptions.
All14 discovery trajectories and development rounds have been inspected for hypothesis choice. Neither the target construction nor development improvement is independent generalization evidence.
No terminal physical energy is learned by this construction. Pure coordinate return-conditioned prototypes do not imply lower strain, valid chemistry or preserved surrounding compatibility.

falsification_and_go_no_go.proceed_now: Implement only the separately named offline mapping/counts/moment audit, preserving original data and prior versions. Mapping and label identity checks are prerequisites.
falsification_and_go_no_go.defer_directions: Do not freeze a signed spatial direction or claim an advantageous causal region from survival enrichment. Defer credit-stratified early-stage rules when support is absent.
offline_rejections: Non-conserving ancestry, wrong label-slot mapping or source mismatch
Credit/high-low summaries that encode extinction or undefined correlation as0
Claims of full-window evidence assembled from only late supported nodes
No within-survivor variation or nearly identical teachers after exact ancestry/geometry deduplication
Apparent credit effects disappear or reverse under equal-batch/root sensitivity, or are explained entirely by same-node score without additional information
falsification_and_go_no_go.future_trial_hypothesis: At matched geometry/controller/dose, a terminal-label-conditioned ancestor library retains predicted score benefit better through native continuation than an instantaneous-label library. This is an untested hypothesis, not a new approved run.
falsification_and_go_no_go.future_trial_rejection: If only recorded head99 improves while decoded terminal rescore does not, the primary affinity objective is not met. Preserve all failures and physical/diversity tradeoffs; do not retroactively redefine the objective or claim improved biochemical affinity.
falsification_and_go_no_go.no_execution_claim: No new reward, GPU FD, complete zero check or molecule generation was performed.

execution_ready_semantics: Proposal and source-label audit only; a new terminal-credit reference/reward has not been implemented, compiled, or validated.
